file_dispositions.reason: The Linux pinned native run confirms initialization and promotion distinctions, but signed-error, RTC, mapping-failure, cross-platform and durable-persistence obligations remain open.
State/API contract is pinned; exact compiled layout variants and all lifecycle callers remain outside this run.
Signed read/write/size and unchecked map/truncate contracts are source-confirmed; backend-wide failure behavior is not fully exercised.
Pinned save-size constants were checked; wider memory ABI review is not part of this lane.
Save bus auto-detection and direct initializer callers are traced; complete memory-bus semantic review remains out of scope.
Savedata state serialization/deserialization calls are traced, but save-byte identity and restore interleavings were not exercised here.
VFile ownership, replacement and clean caller paths are traced; replacement failure and long-lived persistence behavior remain untested.
Clone/restore callers expose the ignored-output-write result; broader caller contracts and allocation-failure cases remain open.
Forced save-type and RTC-load reachability is traced; game-specific override behavior is not exhaustively reviewed.
EEPROM DMA read/write entry points are traced; serial bit timing and all transfer lengths are not certified.
Flash growth and import/export consumers are located; all import size/checksum paths are not reviewed.
Linux backend selection is pinned; platform-specific backend selection remains untested.
POSIX FD map/growth/persistence bytes were exercised; Windows and non-mmap branches and injected operation failures remain open.
Zero-initializing expansion, no-expand memory VFile and read-only writer semantics were source-traced; only the read-only writer was exercised natively.
stdio growth writes zero chunks and mapping copies are source-traced; backend was not enabled in the test build.
Anonymous allocations are confirmed calloc-zeroed; cross-platform allocator and allocation-failure behavior remain open.

objections_and_resolution.objection: PR #13's mock's zero-extension cannot by itself establish the real VFile result; the direct Flash1M growth path does not explicitly fill a pre-existing 64-KiB file's second bank.
objections_and_resolution.independent_resolution: Confirmed on the pinned Linux VFileFD backend: ftruncate grows the file before MAP_SHARED mapping; bytes in the added bank read as 0x00 both through savedata->data and a separate file descriptor. This is a backend-specific native observation, not a universal platform claim.

objections_and_resolution.objection: A direct 8-KiB EEPROM initialization fills only bytes below the 512-byte threshold; PR #13's result must be checked against a real backend.
objections_and_resolution.independent_resolution: Confirmed on pinned Linux VFileFD for both a pre-existing 512-byte save and an empty file. Existing 512-byte contents persist and the added upper range is 0x00; an empty file gets 0xFF only in its first 512 bytes. The paired empty 512-byte save control initializes its entire range to 0xFF.

objections_and_resolution.objection: The statement that promotion routines fill new storage is incomplete: both routines return early without a VFile, before filling any new bytes.
objections_and_resolution.independent_resolution: Pinned native Linux file-backed Flash and EEPROM promotion writes 0xFF into the new range. Native anonymous Flash promotion leaves the new bank zero; anonymous EEPROM promotion leaves untouched upper bytes zero (the first explicitly written byte becomes 0x80).

objections_and_resolution.objection: The VFile interface returns signed ssize_t, but clone/load copy paths pass read counts to size_t write arguments and do not consistently propagate output errors.
objections_and_resolution.independent_resolution: Native VFileFromConstMemory refuses writes with -1. GBASavedataClone nevertheless reports success after copying from a valid native FD VFile, confirming ignored destination-write failures. The separate negative-source-read conversion and load-path behavior remain source-only and need fault injection.

objections_and_resolution.objection: Negative VFile sizes and failed truncate/map operations are not checked before pointer arithmetic or memset; RTCRead converts a signed read result to size_t before checking its length.
objections_and_resolution.independent_resolution: Source confirms the unchecked conversions and operations; VFileFD can return -1 from size/fstat and NULL from map. The native run did not inject those failures or execute RTCRead failure paths.

objections_and_resolution.objection: A passing mapped-memory observation does not establish durable save persistence, RTC trailer correctness, or recovery after short writes/remap failures.
objections_and_resolution.independent_resolution: The native run checked visible on-disk bytes for tested extension/promotion paths only. Clean/sync and RTC unmap/write/remap ordering was traced but not power-failure or fault-injection tested.

negative_controls.native_savedata_control: EEPROM512 empty-file full 0xFF initialization, contrasted with 8-KiB EEPROM's partial fill
negative_controls.native_error_path: read-only VFileFromConstMemory write returns -1 while GBASavedataClone reports success

unresolved_obligations: Inject negative VFile read, short/failed write, negative size, failed truncate, NULL map, failed unmap and failed sync; verify cleanup and no invalid pointer use.
Exercise GBASavedataLoad's copy/extension path and RTCRead's negative/short read path under sanitizers.
Verify Windows, stdio VFile, 3DS and PSP2 backend semantics; this executable ran Linux POSIX VFileFD only.
Trace RTC trailer seek/unmap/write/remap and Flash bank pointer restoration under remap/write failure.
Test crash/power-loss durability, host save tooling/editor interoperability and user-visible game saves.
Review all 800 source lines and cross-file obligations with a maintainer before proposing any independently approved file disposition; no approval is requested here.
